issue.title: Add Comment Count and Commented Marker to My Work Rows
issue.body: My Work chapter rows show a chapter's stage, sync state, and last activity, but nothing about the comments on it. A translator or Observer scanning the list cannot tell which chapters have discussion or which ones they have already commented on. This ticket adds those two indicators to each row. ## Functional Requirements ### Comment Count - Show the chapter's comment count with a `li:message-square` icon on each My Work chapter row. ### Commented Marker - Show a `li:message-square-check` marker on a chapter row when the current user has already commented on that chapter. > **Note:** The counts and markers read the comments created in #451, and the rows they appear on are defined in #505.
